q: Seward's Rokhlin entropy h_Rok extends entropy to actions of all groups (not just sofic ones) as:
opts: The topological entropy of the action
inf_ξ H(ξ|ξ⁻) where the infimum is over generating partitions ξ (similar to KS but for non-amenable groups)
The KS entropy of the associated Bernoulli shift
The Lyapunov exponent of the cocycle
exp: Seward (2014–2020): Rokhlin entropy = inf over generating partitions ξ of the conditional entropy H(ξ|ξ⁻). This is well-defined for all groups. For sofic groups, h_Rok = h_Σ (sofic entropy). For Bernoulli shifts, h_Rok = H(μ₀) universally.
